# wwwdot.dev

> wwwdot.dev is an AI engineering studio that designs, engineers and ships AI products, SaaS platforms, automation systems and interactive digital experiences for startups and enterprises.

AI engineering studio. We partner with startups and enterprises to design, engineer and launch AI products, SaaS platforms, automation systems and interactive digital experiences.

- **Type:** AI Engineering Studio
- **Philosophy:** WE WRITE WORKFLOWS™
- **Engagement:** Direct with the engineering team, no agency layer
- **Contact:** contact@wwwdot.dev
- **Site:** https://www.wwwdot.dev

## Services

### AI Development
Agents that do real work.
- AI agents and copilots
- AI trading / portfolio agents
- AI research assistants
- AI CRM and support agents
- Workflow automation tools
- Price prediction models
- AI-powered dashboards

### Full-Stack Development
Complete products, not pages.
- Websites, web apps, static sites
- SaaS platforms
- CRM / ERP systems
- Admin dashboards
- Custom API integrations
- Mobile-friendly PWA apps

### Blockchain & Smart Contracts
Audited patterns, gas-optimized code.
- Token development (ERC20, BEP20)
- NFT smart contracts & marketplaces
- Smart contracts for games
- Staking contracts
- Vesting & lockup contracts
- Liquidity pool + AMM contracts
- Custom wallet integration
- Multi-chain bridges
- Layer-2 / rollup chain setup
- Custom block explorer

### DeFi Protocol Development
From DEX to derivatives, end to end.
- DEX (AMM / orderbook)
- Perp exchange
- Lending / borrowing protocol
- Yield farming systems
- Stablecoin modules
- Opinion markets (yes/no markets)
- Derivatives & synthetic assets
- Liquidity mining UI
- Trading dashboards

### Tokenization & RWA Systems
Real-world assets, brought on-chain.
- Real estate tokenization
- RWA onboarding dashboard
- Fractional ownership engine
- Rent distribution automation

- Tokenized marketplace
- KYC-gated asset access

### P2P Platforms
Escrow-protected trading at scale.
- Crypto P2P exchange (Binance-style)
- Escrow-based P2P trading
- Stablecoin P2P desk
- KYC / verification module
- Automated dispute resolution

### Payments & Finance Automation
Fiat and crypto, one flow.
- Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal integration
- Fiat-to-crypto flow
- Subscription billing
- Micro-payments
- Pay-per-use credit wallet

### Marketplace Development
Two-sided platforms that transact.
- NFT marketplace
- Service / task marketplace (Fiverr-style)
- Tokenized asset marketplace
- P2P item buy/sell apps

### DAO & Governance
On-chain decisions, transparent treasury.
- Governance token
- Voting dashboard
- On-chain proposals
- Treasury dashboard

## Selected work

- **FactoryOS**: Industrial OS coordinating robotic assembly, vision and maintenance in real time. (Next.js, IoT, Python)
- **AUREN**: Luxury fashion house editorial with campaign films and seasonal lookbooks. (Next.js, GSAP, Sanity)
- **QuantOS**: Institutional-grade AI quant research, backtesting and execution platform. (React, WebSocket, Python)
- **ORCHESTRA Console**: Live multi-agent network for routing, inspecting and tracing agent runs. (React, WebSocket, D3.js)
- **HYPE Terminal**: Pro crypto DEX trading terminal with real-time charts and on-chain execution. (React, WebSocket, Web3)
- **GeoIQ**: SaaS that measures brand visibility inside AI search. (React, PostgreSQL, OpenAI)
- **ORCHESTRA**: AI orchestration platform routing GPT, Claude and Gemini through one layer. (Next.js, MCP, OpenAI)
- **P2PxBT**: Peer-to-peer crypto exchange with escrow-protected trades. (React, Node.js, Web3)
- **AXIOM**: Crypto AI agent platform executing strategy inside on-chain guardrails. (React, GSAP, Three.js)
- **VIVID**: Fashion eyewear ecommerce with cinematic product pages. (Next.js, Shopify, GSAP)
- **L1 Chain**: Custom Layer 1 blockchain with PoS consensus and EVM compatibility. (Rust, Solidity, Go)
- **YAP**: Consumer AI app generating talking 3D characters from a single prompt. (React, Node.js, OpenAI)
- **PREDIKT**: Prediction market with on-chain settlement. (Solidity, React, The Graph)
- **AURA**: Luxury residence tower landing with a cinematic 3D hero. (Next.js, GSAP, Three.js)

## FAQ

### What does wwwdot.dev build?
wwwdot.dev is an AI engineering studio that builds AI products, AI agents, SaaS platforms, automation systems, web applications and blockchain protocols. Work spans discovery and architecture through to production deployment, in stacks including Next.js, React, Python, Solidity and Node.js.

### How much does it cost to build an AI product or SaaS platform?
Cost tracks scope rather than a fixed price list. A landing experience is the smallest engagement, an MVP is the most common, and a full AI platform or DeFi protocol is the largest. wwwdot.dev gives a fixed scope and figure after a discovery call, before any work begins, so the number is not a moving estimate.

### How long does it take to build an AI SaaS MVP?
A landing experience runs 1 to 2 weeks, an MVP 4 to 8 weeks, and a full AI platform or DeFi protocol 2 to 4 months. wwwdot.dev commits to a concrete timeline after the discovery call and runs weekly demos against it, so slippage is visible in the first week rather than the last.

### How do you choose an AI development company?
Ask who actually writes the code, whether you get the repository, and how progress is demonstrated. At wwwdot.dev one engineering lead owns the account end to end, you receive the full codebase with documentation, and progress is shown as working software every week rather than status reports.

### How do you work with clients?
wwwdot.dev partners directly with the founding or product team. One engineering lead owns the account end to end, so there is no agency layer and no handoff between the people who architect the system and the people who ship it.

### What does an engagement include?
Discovery and scope, system and data architecture, design, engineering, deployment and a support window. Clients receive the full codebase with documentation, and can either take it in-house or continue on a retainer.

### How do you handle security and audits?
wwwdot.dev builds against audited patterns such as OpenZeppelin, runs static analysis and full test coverage, and coordinates third-party audits for any contract holding real value before it reaches mainnet.

### Do you sign NDAs?
Yes, before any technical discussion if preferred. Your idea, data and codebase stay confidential either way.

## Direct answers

**What is wwwdot.dev?**
wwwdot.dev is an AI engineering studio that designs, engineers and ships AI products, SaaS platforms, automation systems and interactive digital experiences for startups and enterprises.

**What does wwwdot.dev do?**
wwwdot.dev designs, engineers and ships AI products, AI agents, SaaS platforms, automation systems, web applications and blockchain protocols, from discovery and architecture through to production deployment.

**Who is wwwdot.dev for?**
Startups and enterprises that need a production-grade product built rather than a prototype. Typical clients are founding teams shipping a first AI or SaaS product, and established companies adding AI capability to an existing platform.

**What makes wwwdot.dev different from a development agency?**
One engineering lead owns the account end to end. There is no agency layer, no account manager, and no handoff between the people who architect the system and the people who ship it. Clients receive the full codebase with documentation.

**What technologies does wwwdot.dev use?**
D3.js, GSAP, Go, IoT, MCP, Next.js, Node.js, OpenAI, PostgreSQL, Python, React, Rust, Sanity, Shopify, Solidity, The Graph, Three.js, Web3, WebSocket.

**How long does a project take?**
Landing experience 1 to 2 weeks. MVP 4 to 8 weeks. AI platform or DeFi protocol 2 to 4 months. A concrete timeline is committed after the discovery call, with weekly demos against it.

**How do I contact wwwdot.dev?**
Email contact@wwwdot.dev, or use the enquiry form at https://www.wwwdot.dev.
